Belroll bundles the following runtime dependencies locally:

React and React DOM 19.2.0
Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates.
MIT license: ./licenses/react-LICENSE.txt
https://github.com/facebook/react

viem 2.57.16, wagmi 2.19.5 (with @wagmi/core and @wagmi/connectors), ox and abitype
Copyright (c) weth, LLC and contributors
MIT licenses: ./licenses/viem-LICENSE.txt, ./licenses/wagmi-LICENSE.txt,
./licenses/ox-LICENSE.txt, ./licenses/abitype-LICENSE.txt
https://github.com/wevm

@tanstack/react-query 5.107.0
MIT license: ./licenses/tanstack-query-LICENSE.txt
https://github.com/TanStack/query

@noble/curves 1.9.1 and @noble/hashes
Copyright (c) Paul Miller
MIT license: ./licenses/noble-curves-LICENSE.txt, ./licenses/noble-hashes-LICENSE.txt
https://github.com/paulmillr/noble-curves

Manrope variable font, packaged by @fontsource-variable/manrope 5.3.0
Copyright 2019 The Manrope Project Authors
SIL Open Font License 1.1: ./licenses/manrope-LICENSE.txt
https://github.com/sharanda/manrope

The Belroll mark, interface icons and share graphic are authored SVGs in this
repository. No external asset requests or hosted fonts are required. The only network
requests go to the configured Base RPC endpoint and the user's wallet.
